question.text: Mr. Arvind Menon, trustee of Vindhya Event-Driven Fund (Cat III AIF), is asked whether the fund must deduct TDS under Section 194LBB of the ITA on income distributed to investors. What is the correct position?

answer.text: Yes, deduct 10% on resident and 20% on non-resident investors on all income
Yes, but only on business income
No - Category III AIFs do not have Section 115UB pass-through status; tax is discharged at the fund level, so Section 194LBB withholding does not apply
Yes, deduct at MMR 42.744% on all investors

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook (pp. 362, 365, 374, 376) sets out that Category III AIFs have no pass-through status, that Section 115UB / Investment Fund pass-through is described separately, and that fund-level tax is discharged as representative assessee. Page 376 places Section 194LBB withholding within the Investment Fund (Cat I/II) framework. As a legal inference, with no Section 115UB pass-through, Section 194LBB has no operative scope for Category III, and the fund pays at fund level instead. The Trap: Options A, B and D all assume Category III follows Category I/II withholding mechanics. Candidates who memorise 194LBB as a generic AIF TDS rule miss that its scope is tied to the Investment Fund definition that Category III is outside. Note: Distribution reporting forms (e.g., 64C/64D) sit within the Investment Fund compliance framework in the workbook, so they should not be used as evidence for Category III practice.
